datasets.name: Pre-disaster remote sensing image of Chagou Formation

methods.name: Landslide dynamic visualization method
methods.summary: A method that establishes dynamic equations of the landslide evolution process (incorporating time-varying driving force and slidability eigenvalue) and calibrates model parameters using pre- and post-disaster remote sensing data to reconstruct and visualize the landslide event.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and other input datasets are not mentioned or linked. The custom code for the landslide dynamic visualization method is not available.
